title: Insurance Claim Services File Closing Standard
content:
**Standard.** A claim file is settled when its carrier receivable reaches zero through carrier payments and write-offs. A settled file is closed once its deductible due is zero and every job linked to it is closed; a file whose deductible is still owed stays settled. Denied and withdrawn files are not settled or closed through this path.

The standard applies to every Insurance Claim Services claim file that reaches settlement.

| File state | Moves to |
|---|---|
| approved, carrier receivable reduced to zero by carrier payments and write-offs | settled |
| settled, deductible due zero, every linked job closed | closed |
| settled, deductible still owed | stays settled |
| denied or withdrawn | not settled or closed through this path |

*Example (hypothetical):* a file whose carrier receivable reached zero, with a deductible due of 0.00 and one linked rebuild contract still open, stays settled until that contract closes.
